about: Opens a panel of rows from a button, from a right click on a region, or from a row of another menu. A plain row runs an action, and a checkbox or radio row sets a value. The arrow keys and typeahead move the highlight.

highlight.about: Each highlight at each size. Open a menu and move the pointer or the arrow keys over its rows. A critical row keeps the error palette under the highlight.
highlight.title: Highlights and sizes

inset.about: A column's menu without and with `inset`. The sort rows and the hide row lead with an icon, and the checkbox row does not. With `inset`, the checkbox row starts its text after the gutter an icon and its gap take, level with the text of the icon rows.
inset.title: Gutter

long.about: Twenty-four rows. Open the menu: the panel stops at the room left in the window and scrolls, and the arrow keys scroll the highlighted row into view.
long.title: Long lists

marks.about: Each workspace row leads with its initial in a square mark and reads its name over its plan. The check marks the current workspace, and the two action rows put their icons in the same square.
marks.title: Marks and descriptions

over.about: A right click, a long press or Shift+F10 on the region opens the menu at the pointer. The region keeps its own role and look.
over.title: Context menu

palette.about: The eight palettes. Open a menu and highlight a row to see its palette. The panel sets the palette, and every row and submenu inherits it. A critical row keeps the error palette in each.
palette.title: Palettes

placements.about: Six placements against the trigger, each with an arrow that points at it. The machine flips a panel that would cross the edge of the window to the opposite side.
placements.title: Placements

rtl.about: The menu in a right-to-left document. The panel aligns to the trigger's right edge, a submenu opens to the left, and the submenu row's chevron points to the left.
rtl.title: Right to left

submenus.about: A pointer on a row that opens a submenu opens it after a short delay, beside the panel and level with its row. The right arrow opens it from the keyboard, and the left arrow closes it.
submenus.title: Submenus

title: Menu

variant.about: The three looks. `surface` fills the panel with `bg.popover` inside a hairline edge. `elevated` fills it with `bg.panel` under a large shadow. `glass` applies the theme's glass layer style.
variant.title: Looks
